description.subtitle: Nike cotton reflective windbreaker jacket from FC Barcelona - Burgundy
description.intro: The Nike Barcelona Tech Fleece WindRunner Reflect windbreaker combines the identity of FC Barcelona with the modern design of the Nike Tech collection. Its soft Fleece fabric inside and out brings warmth and comfort without giving up a sporty and minimalist aesthetic. The Hoodie, full zip closure and reflective details complete a versatile garment to show off the colors of Barça in the day to day.
key_benefits: Comfort and warmth: Fleece fabric provides a soft and pleasant feel inside and out.
Additional Protection: The Hoodie helps to provide more coverage when you need it.
Functional design: The complete zipper closure allows easy regulation of the cover.
Detalles reflectantes: Los elementos Nike Tech aportan un acabado distintivo y moderno.
Blaugrana identity: The FC Barcelona shield allows to show the passion for the club with a sporty style.
